OD-B12-S01-T01.line: The ship left Ocean's stream and came again to Aeaea, where young Dawn keeps her dancing-lawns; they beached her on the sand and slept where the surf broke.

OD-B12-S01-T02.line: At dawn they fetched Elpenor's body from Circe's roof, and wept, and burned him with all his armor, and heaped a mound above the ashes.

OD-B12-S01-T03.line: And on the crown of the mound they planted his shapely oar, as the dead man had asked.
OD-B12-S01-T03.direction: sets the oar in the earth

OD-B12-S01-T04.line: Unflinching men — you have gone down living to the house of Death; twice-dying, when all others die once. Eat now, and drink till nightfall; at dawn you sail, and I myself will show you the road.
OD-B12-S01-T04.direction: arrives with bread, meat, and red wine

OD-B12-S02-T01.line: Listen well, for the road ahead has teeth. First the Sirens, who enchant every man that comes near them; then a strait between two terrors, Scylla and Charybdis; and beyond, Thrinacia, where the Sun keeps his cattle.
OD-B12-S02-T01.direction: draws him aside from the crew

OD-B12-S02-T02.line: Knead sweet wax and stop your men's ears; if you yourself must hear, let them bind you upright to the mast — and bind you tighter when you beg. Hug Scylla's cliff and row for your lives, for better six men lost than the whole ship swallowed by Charybdis. And on Thrinacia touch nothing — leave the Sun's herds unharmed, and you may yet come home.

OD-B12-S02-T03.line: But tell me truly, goddess — when she strikes at my men, can I not stand to her with spear and sword and beat her off?

OD-B12-S02-T04.line: Stubborn man — still spoiling for war and toil, still refusing to bow even to the gods! She is not mortal; she is deathless evil, terrible and wild, and not to be fought. Against Scylla there is no defense but flight.

OD-B12-S02-T05.line: At dawn they went down to the swift ship, and the goddess sent a fair wind astern, filling the sail.

OD-B12-S03-T01.line: Then the wind fell to a dead calm — some god lulled the waves to sleep — and ahead lay the island of the Sirens.

OD-B12-S03-T02.line: Ears to me, each man in turn — this wax stays till we are long past that shore.
OD-B12-S03-T02.direction: kneads warm wax, seals every ear

OD-B12-S03-T03.line: They bound him hand and foot, upright in the mast-step, and beat the sea white beneath their oars past the flowering shore.

OD-B12-S03-T04.line: Come here, far-famed Odysseus, great glory of the Achaeans — stay your ship and hear our voices. No man has ever rowed past us till he heard the honeyed song from our lips, and went away delighted, knowing more than he knew. For we know all that Argives and Trojans suffered on Troy's wide plain by the will of the gods — we know everything that comes to pass on the nourishing earth.
OD-B12-S03-T04.direction: sing motionless from the flowered shore

OD-B12-S03-T05.line: Loose me! Loose me — I must hear it all!
OD-B12-S03-T05.direction: strains at the ropes, jerks his brows in signal

OD-B12-S03-T06.line: But Perimedes and Eurylochus rose and lashed him tighter still, and the crew rowed until the song sank beneath the sound of the sea.

OD-B12-S04-T01.line: Straightway smoke, and a great breaker, and the boom of surf: Charybdis, sucking down the salt water and spewing it high like a cauldron on fierce fire — and the oars flew from their frightened hands.

OD-B12-S04-T02.line: Row, friends — we have been in worse and lived, and this too we shall remember. Helmsman, hold her off that smoke and hug the cliff — keep to the rock, or you kill us all.
OD-B12-S04-T02.direction: hides the six-fold price to come

OD-B12-S04-T03.line: Come then, if you dare come at me.
OD-B12-S04-T03.direction: arms fully, scans the mist-hung rock face

OD-B12-S04-T04.direction: hoisted screaming from the benches into the cliff's mouth

OD-B12-S04-T05.line: Like a fisherman swinging his catch to shore she swung them up to her rock, screaming, and ate them at her door — still stretching out their hands to him. Of all he saw upon the sea, that was the most pitiful.

OD-B12-S05-T01.line: Free of the rocks, they raised the noble island of the Sun, and heard the lowing of cattle in the pens and the bleating of sheep — the herds of Helios, who sees all things.

OD-B12-S05-T02.line: Row on — we do not land here. Tiresias and Circe both warned me alike: our worst harm waits on that island. Call me merciless if you will, Eurylochus — I would keep you alive.

OD-B12-S05-T03.line: But Eurylochus had the weary crew behind him, and Odysseus yielded to one night's landing — first swearing every man by solemn oath to touch neither cow nor sheep, but eat only the stores that Circe gave.
OD-B12-S05-T03.direction: seals the compromise with an oath

OD-B12-S05-T04.line: Then a month of South Wind, blowing without end; and when the ship's stores gave out they scoured the island with bent hooks for fish and birds, hunger gnawing their bellies.

OD-B12-S05-T05.line: Remember what you swore, friends — those herds belong to the Sun. Fish, fowl, roots, anything — but not the cattle.
OD-B12-S05-T05.direction: walks the camp, holding the line

OD-B12-S06-T01.line: When the last of Circe's stores was gone, Odysseus went up-island to pray the gods for a road home — and they poured sweet sleep over his eyelids.
OD-B12-S06-T01.direction: separates the captain from his crew

OD-B12-S06-T02.line: All deaths are hateful, brothers, but hunger is the meanest death of all. Drive off the best of the Sun's cattle — better one gulp of the wave than wasting thin on a desert island. And we will build Helios a rich temple in Ithaca, and heap it with offerings.

OD-B12-S06-T03.line: No barley — strip young oak leaves. No wine — pour water. Now pray, and cut.
OD-B12-S06-T03.direction: leads the makeshift sacrifice, kills and roasts

OD-B12-S06-T04.line: Then the gods showed them portents: the flayed hides crawled, and the meat lowed on the spits, raw and roasted, with the voice of cattle.

OD-B12-S06-T05.line: Swift Lampetie of the trailing robes ran to Helios with the news, and the Sun cried out to Zeus: punish them, father, or I go down to Hades and shine among the dead.

OD-B12-S07-T01.line: What have you done — you have slaughtered the Sun's own herds while I slept! O father Zeus, you lulled me to my ruin. This is doom, and no offering on earth will unmake it.
OD-B12-S07-T01.direction: groans at the smell of roasting meat

OD-B12-S07-T02.line: Six days they feasted on the finest of the cattle; on the seventh the storm-wind fell, and they stepped the mast and stood out to open sea.

OD-B12-S07-T03.line: Now pay the Sun his price.
OD-B12-S07-T03.direction: piles a black cloud, strikes the mast with the bolt

OD-B12-S07-T04.line: The bolt burst the ship end to end; she spun, filled with sulphur-smoke, and the men went overboard like sea-crows around the black hull — and the god took their homecoming away.
OD-B12-S07-T04.direction: drowns the last of the crew

OD-B12-S07-T05.line: Hold together — keel and mast and I.
OD-B12-S07-T05.direction: lashes the wreckage with the ox-hide backstay

OD-B12-S07-T06.line: The wind drove him back to Charybdis; he clung to the wild fig tree like a bat till his timbers rose again from the whirl, then dropped and rowed with his hands. Nine days he drifted, and on the tenth night the gods brought him alone to Ogygia — to Calypso.
OD-B12-S07-T06.direction: carries the lone survivor to Calypso

OD-B13-S01-T01.line: There, friends. My story is told, and the telling has emptied me.

OD-B13-S01-T02.line: Bring out one more chest, and let every lord of Phaeacia add a tripod and a cauldron to it. Then set the feast, for our guest sails at sundown and he must leave us glad.

OD-B13-S01-T03.line: Farewell, generous hearts. May the gods repay this house with every good thing.
OD-B13-S01-T03.direction: boards ship, lies down on the stern bed

OD-B13-S01-T04.line: Swifter than a wheeling hawk the ship ran on, and the man who had suffered twenty years of salt and war slept past all sorrow. Before the dawn-star rose, her keel touched Ithaca.
OD-B13-S01-T04.direction: steady, low, over the sleeping man

OD-B13-S01-T05.line: Easy now. Lift him gently, and the treasure after.
OD-B13-S01-T05.direction: carry sleeper and gifts ashore, push off in silence

OD-B13-S02-T01.line: What land is this now, and what people? The very air is a stranger to me.
OD-B13-S02-T01.direction: wakes alone, stares through the mist

OD-B13-S02-T02.line: Tripods, cauldrons, the woven robes, the gold. All of it here, nothing taken. Then why does this shore know nothing of me, unless those sailors dumped me on some foreign coast?
OD-B13-S02-T02.direction: counts the gifts piece by piece

OD-B13-S02-T03.line: Wretched again, and among strangers again. O Zeus, where do I carry all this wealth, and where do I carry myself?

OD-B13-S02-T04.line: Good day to you, stranger. You look like a man who has lost his road.
OD-B13-S02-T04.direction: ambles up in a young shepherd's guise

OD-B13-S03-T01.line: Hear it, Odysseus, and hold your face still. The shepherd boy names this rough land Ithaca, and your heart leaps like a fish behind your teeth, and you let nothing show.

OD-B13-S03-T02.line: And what does he answer? A lie, fresh-minted: he is a Cretan, he says, a killer fleeing blood-price, carried here on a Phoenician ship. One hour home, and already armored in fiction.

OD-B13-S03-T03.line: Cunning, insatiable trickster, even in your own land you will not lay your lies aside! Enough now: I am Athena, daughter of Zeus, and we two are alike, crooked-minded both, you the best of mortals at scheming and I of gods.
OD-B13-S03-T03.direction: disguise falls away, laughing, tall and radiant

OD-B13-S03-T04.line: Hard goddess, where were you all the salt years since Troy burned? You stood at my shoulder then, and after, I never once saw you on my deck while I suffered. Now you come smiling and tell me this is Ithaca, so swear it is not one more mockery.
OD-B13-S03-T04.direction: grief and challenge, equal to equal

OD-B13-S03-T05.line: So that is the shape of it. Poseidon's wrath made open rescue too costly, and you wore silence the way I wear rags. You hid me even from my own eyes to keep me breathing.
OD-B13-S03-T05.direction: turning her reasons over, half forgiving

OD-B13-S04-T01.line: In with them. Your bronze and gold will keep better here than on any beach.
OD-B13-S04-T01.direction: hefts treasure into the nymphs' cave

OD-B13-S04-T02.line: There. No thief alive will shift that stone. Now sit with me under the olive, and let us plot.
OD-B13-S04-T02.direction: seals the cave mouth, sits beneath the olive

OD-B13-S04-T03.line: Count them with me: a hundred lordly young men and more, three years camped in your hall, eating your herds and courting your wife. Two of us against all of those, and I like our odds.

OD-B13-S04-T04.line: Go first to your swineherd Eumaeus, keeper of your pigs and lover of your house, and stay by his fire and question everything. I go to Sparta, to fetch your son home.

OD-B13-S05-T01.line: Hold still now. This will not be kind.
OD-B13-S05-T01.direction: touches him with the wand, skin withers, hair falls

OD-B13-S05-T02.line: Dimmed eyes, wracked limbs, rags fit for burning on an old man's back. No one who ever loved you will look at you twice. Take this staff and this patched beggar's sack, for this is who you are now.

OD-B13-S05-T03.line: So the king goes among his own people as nothing at all: a ruined old man on a mountain path, sent to weigh the hearts of servants, and no eye in Ithaca to know him.

OD-B13-S05-T04.line: To Sparta, for the boy. Walk on, old beggar, and keep to the high path.
OD-B13-S05-T04.direction: departs skyward, he turns toward the farm

OD-B14-S01-T01.line: Smoke, and the smell of pigs. Someone keeps this hill better than the palace keeps itself.

OD-B14-S01-T02.line: Out of the yard four dogs came at him like wolves, and the man dropped his staff and sat down in the dirt, old soldier's craft, letting their fury break over a harmless thing.

OD-B14-S01-T03.line: Back! Off him, you brutes, off! Old man, another moment and you'd have been torn, and the shame of it mine forever.
OD-B14-S01-T03.direction: hurls stones, scatters dogs, lifts the stranger

OD-B14-S01-T04.line: Sit, grandfather, here, my own seat by the fire. Two young pigs I'll dress for us; eat first, and tell your griefs after.
OD-B14-S01-T04.direction: spreads a shaggy goatskin, sets to butchering

OD-B14-S02-T01.line: Forgive the poor meat, old man; young pork is all the suitors leave us. The fattened boars go down the mountain to men who eat a lost king's herds and fear no god watching.

OD-B14-S02-T02.line: My master, and I will say his name, Odysseus, was kind to me past any telling, and the sea has him now, dead in some far water. Every drifter who wants supper sings me a tale that he lives. I have stopped believing songs.

OD-B14-S02-T03.line: Then hear an oath, not a song. By Zeus of guests, by this table and this fire: Odysseus comes home before this year is out. When he stands in his own hall, give me a cloak and tunic then, and not one hour before.

OD-B14-S02-T04.line: Keep your oath, friend, for I'll pay no cloak on it, and Odysseus will not come. Drink your wine and speak of other things; my heart aches enough whenever his name is said.
OD-B14-S02-T04.direction: gentle refusal, refills the cup anyway

OD-B14-S03-T01.line: But you now, who are you, and from where among men? What ship brought you, and what grief? For no man walks to Ithaca.

OD-B14-S03-T02.line: Crete, then Troy, then Egypt in chains, go on, leave nothing out. And this Thesprotian king, say again what he swore to you about Odysseus and the treasure coming home.

OD-B14-S03-T03.line: Mark how he builds it: true harbors, true wars, true hunger, and a false name at the keel. The lie is a net, cast gently, to sound the depth of the swineherd's heart.

OD-B14-S03-T04.line: Poor man, your wanderings wring my heart, and every word of hardship I believe. But the word about Odysseus, no. Why do you good men think a lie will comfort me?

OD-B14-S04-T01.line: Night came down foul, moonless, black rain on a wet west wind, and the herdsmen came in from the pens to the fire, and the cold began its work on the old man's shoulders.

OD-B14-S04-T02.line: Hear a boast from an old soldier, since wine loosens me. One freezing ambush-night at Troy I lay without a cloak, and Odysseus spun a trick on the spot that got one onto my shoulders. Ah, to be that young man tonight, someone in this hut might do the same.
OD-B14-S04-T02.direction: shivering, sly, palms to the fire

OD-B14-S04-T03.line: Well hinted, old man, and no fault in the hint. Here, my spare cloak, sleep warm.
OD-B14-S04-T03.direction: throws a heavy cloak over him

OD-B14-S04-T04.line: The herd won't guard itself in weather like this. Sleep, all of you.
OD-B14-S04-T04.direction: takes spear and fleece, beds down near the pigs

OD-B15-S01-T01.line: Telemachus, wake. It is wrong to wander while your house is eaten hollow. Go home now, before your mother's own kin bend her to marry Eurymachus and your inheritance walks out the door with her.
OD-B15-S01-T01.direction: stands over his bed in the dark

OD-B15-S01-T02.line: And hear this too: the boldest of the suitors lie in ambush in the strait between Ithaca and rocky Same, hungry for your blood before you ever reach home. Keep clear of that channel, sail wide, and sail by night.
OD-B15-S01-T02.direction: urgent, tracing the route in the air

OD-B15-S01-T03.line: When you touch Ithaca, send ship and crew round to the town without you. Go first, on foot, to the swineherd Eumaeus, who keeps faith with your house; sleep there, and send him to tell your mother you are safely home.

OD-B15-S01-T04.line: Pisistratus, up. Yoke the horses, we go home at first light.

OD-B15-S02-T01.line: Menelaus, dear to Zeus, your gifts honor me and I take them gladly. But do not hold me for more feasting; my heart is already on Ithaca, and I fear what rots there while I linger.

OD-B15-S02-T02.line: Take this robe, child, woven by my own hands, for the bride you will one day wed; let your mother keep it till then. And read that eagle with the white goose in its claws as I do: so Odysseus, home from long wandering, will stoop upon the suitors, or he is home already, seeding their ruin.
OD-B15-S02-T02.direction: lays the robe in his arms, eyes on the sky

OD-B15-S02-T03.line: So the whips came down and the horses flew, through Phera as the sun set, and on to sandy Pylos with the dawn.

OD-B15-S02-T04.line: Son of Nestor, will you do me one kindness more, and drive me past your father's gates, straight down to my ship? Old Nestor's welcome is warm, but it does not let go, and I cannot lose a night to it.

OD-B15-S03-T01.line: Aboard, men, rig the mast and run out the oars. We sail for home now, not at dawn.

OD-B15-S03-T02.line: Friend, by your sacrifice and by the god you pour to, tell me truly who you are, and then hear me. I have killed a kinsman in Argos, and his brothers hunt my life across the islands. Take me aboard, for I am a suppliant and a seer, and I have nowhere on this earth to stand.
OD-B15-S03-T02.direction: breathless, glancing back down the road

OD-B15-S03-T03.line: I will not push away a man who asks. Come aboard; you'll share what we have, and in Ithaca you will be made welcome.
OD-B15-S03-T03.direction: takes his spear, hands him up the plank

OD-B15-S03-T04.line: Grey-eyed Athena sent the wind astern, and the black ship ran through the dark, past Elis and the needle islands, toward Ithaca and the ambush that waited in the strait.

OD-B15-S04-T01.line: At dawn, friend, I'll go down to the town and beg at the great house; perhaps the suitors need a man to carve meat and pour wine. I refuse to eat your bread another day and give nothing back.

OD-B15-S04-T02.line: Tell me of old Laertes, does he still live? And the mother of Odysseus, what became of her? And you yourself, friend: what land bore you, and how did you come to serve this house?

OD-B15-S04-T03.line: I was a king's son once, on the island men call Syria, till a Phoenician woman of my father's house sold me to her traders for trinkets and a passage home. Seven days we ran before the wind; on the seventh she dropped dead in the hold, and they carried me on like cargo, to sell.

OD-B15-S04-T04.line: Come, child. This house is yours now.
OD-B15-S04-T04.direction: memory figure takes the bought boy's hand

OD-B15-S05-T01.line: And as the ship closed on Ithaca, a hawk, Apollo's swift messenger, swept by on the right with a dove torn in its talons, and the feathers fell between Telemachus and the sea.

OD-B15-S05-T02.line: The bird flew on your right hand, Telemachus, no house in Ithaca out-kings yours; the power stays with your line forever!
OD-B15-S05-T02.direction: seizes his arm, eyes on the hawk

OD-B15-S05-T03.line: Crew, take her round to the town harbor without me; I go inland to look over my farms. Tonight I lodge with the herdsmen, and tomorrow evening I'll set out a feast to pay you for the voyage.
OD-B15-S05-T03.direction: calm command, already scanning the hills

OD-B15-S05-T04.line: Piraeus will keep you honorably, friend, until I send for you. Trust him as you would me.
OD-B15-S05-T04.direction: binds his sandals, strikes inland alone

OD-B16-S01-T01.line: Down, good dogs. You still know my step.
OD-B16-S01-T01.direction: the hounds fawn around him without one bark

OD-B16-S01-T02.line: Light of my eyes, you came back to me. I never thought to see you walk through that gate again.
OD-B16-S01-T02.direction: bowl falls, wine spills, he kisses his head and both hands, weeping

OD-B16-S01-T03.line: Sit here, young lord. The stool is yours. I will find a place by the door.
OD-B16-S01-T03.direction: rises stiffly and sweeps the fleece aside

OD-B16-S01-T04.line: Keep your seat, stranger. Eumaeus will pile me brushwood. Tell me instead who you are, and what ship set you down on Ithaca.
OD-B16-S01-T04.direction: ducks under the lintel and sits beside him

OD-B16-S02-T01.line: A Cretan, then, and hard luck carried you here. Eumaeus, go quietly to my mother and tell her I am home. Her ears only, no crier in the yard.
OD-B16-S02-T01.direction: lowers his voice, glancing at the stranger

OD-B16-S02-T02.line: It is done. I take the low road and I say it to no one else.
OD-B16-S02-T02.direction: binds his sandals and starts down the farm road to town

OD-B16-S02-T03.direction: stands tall at the gate and beckons him out, unseen by the son

OD-B16-S02-T04.direction: sets down his staff and steps into the yard after her

OD-B16-S03-T01.line: Stand straight, son of Laertes. The years come off you now.
OD-B16-S03-T01.direction: golden wand across him; skin darkens, beard blackens, fresh cloak falls

OD-B16-S03-T02.direction: he ducks back through the low door, tall and shining

OD-B16-S03-T03.line: Stranger, you are changed. Some god is standing in this hut, and I have nothing here to offer you.
OD-B16-S03-T03.direction: starts back, drops his eyes, lifts both hands

OD-B16-S03-T04.line: I am no god. Why do you liken me to the immortals? I am your father, Telemachus, the man you have grieved for all these years.
OD-B16-S03-T04.direction: steps into the firelight, arms open

OD-B16-S03-T05.line: You are not my father. No mortal man makes himself young at will, and no beggar puts on a king in one breath. This is a god's work, and it is mocking my grief.
OD-B16-S03-T05.direction: shakes his head, backing toward the wall

OD-B16-S03-T06.direction: they cling and cry, shrill as birds robbed of their young

OD-B16-S04-T01.line: The Phaeacians rowed me home asleep and left me with their gifts on the shore. Now tell me plainly: how many suitors, and out of what houses?
OD-B16-S04-T01.direction: sits close, keeping his voice under the fire's noise

OD-B16-S04-T02.line: Fifty-two from Dulichium, twenty-four from Same, twenty from Zacynthus, twelve of Ithaca itself, with a herald and a singer beside them. A hundred and eight, Father, and we are two. Two men cannot stand against so many in that hall.
OD-B16-S04-T02.direction: counts them off on his fingers

OD-B16-S04-T03.line: Zeus and Athena stand with us, and they are worth more than a hundred spears. Carry every weapon out of the hall to the storeroom, and leave two swords, two spears, two shields where our hands can reach them.

OD-B16-S04-T04.line: I will go back and swallow their laughter without a word. Not my mother, not Laertes. No one hears this from me.
OD-B16-S04-T04.direction: takes up his spear and sets his face

OD-B16-S04-T05.line: Let Eumaeus walk the stranger down to town when the sun is high, and let him beg his bread there like any other.
OD-B16-S04-T05.direction: clasps his father's hand at the door

OD-B16-S05-T01.line: Ship the oars. We are inside the point, and their sail is nowhere.
OD-B16-S05-T01.direction: the ship slips into harbor ahead of the ambush

OD-B16-S05-T02.line: Hear it in the hall. Telemachus, son of Odysseus, has come home to Ithaca this hour, safe out of Pylos, and his ship lies drawn up in the harbor.
OD-B16-S05-T02.direction: the herald calls it from the courtyard stones

OD-B16-S05-T03.line: The suitors leave their seats and crowd into the yard, staring at one another. The boy they meant to bury is walking in through his own gate.
OD-B16-S05-T03.direction: steps aside as the crowd surges

OD-B16-S05-T04.line: The sea has failed us and their ship is past our teeth. Then take him on the road outside town, in the fields, before he stands in assembly and turns the people against us.
OD-B16-S05-T04.direction: leans in over the wine, voice low and fast

OD-B16-S05-T05.line: I will not lift a hand against a king's son until the gods say so. Ask Zeus for a sign first. If the omens come out favorable, I will strike the blow myself; if they do not, I tell you to leave him alone.
OD-B16-S05-T05.direction: sets down his cup and holds the table's eye

OD-B16-S05-T06.line: Antinous, your own father came here hunted, and Odysseus sheltered him under this roof. This is how you pay that debt, by plotting my son's death. Plot it again and every man on Ithaca hears it from my own mouth.
OD-B16-S05-T06.direction: comes down to the threshold, veil drawn across her face

OD-B16-S06-T01.line: Bend down again, old wanderer. The swineherd is on the path, and he must find nothing here but rags.
OD-B16-S06-T01.direction: wand touch; shoulders stoop, skin withers, the rags return

OD-B16-S06-T02.line: The prince is home and safe, and I put the word in the queen's ear myself. The ship that lay in wait for him came slinking into harbor with empty hands.
OD-B16-S06-T02.direction: drops his stick by the door, breathing hard from the road

OD-B16-S06-T03.line: In that same hour a man from the crew reaches Penelope with the same news, so the queen hears twice what the suitors dread once.
OD-B16-S06-T03.direction: turns the audience toward the palace

OD-B16-S06-T04.line: They eat their supper in the firelight and lie down. The father says nothing, the son says nothing, and the secret sleeps between them.
OD-B16-S06-T04.direction: lets the fire settle into embers

OD-B17-S01-T01.line: Eumaeus, bring the stranger down to town later in the day and let him beg his bread where he can. I go ahead to the house at first light.
OD-B17-S01-T01.direction: shoulders his spear in the gray dawn

OD-B17-S01-T02.direction: walks the long road and comes in through the courtyard gate

OD-B17-S01-T03.line: You are alive. Come here, child, let me look at you.
OD-B17-S01-T03.direction: the old nurse runs weeping and wraps him in her arms

OD-B17-S01-T04.line: Nestor gave me every honor but no news. Menelaus swore that the old sea god told him my father lives, held on an island by a nymph, with no ship to carry him. That is all I bring you, Mother. Nothing more.
OD-B17-S01-T04.direction: meets her eyes steadily, giving nothing away

OD-B17-S01-T05.line: Hear my oath, lady, by Zeus and by this table that took me in. Odysseus is on Ithaca soil this day, sitting still or already moving, and he is sowing death for these men.
OD-B17-S01-T05.direction: rises, reading the light in the doorway

OD-B17-S02-T01.line: Lean on the staff, old man. The town road is long and my legs are older than they look.
OD-B17-S02-T01.direction: shoulders the wallet and sets a slow pace

OD-B17-S02-T02.line: At the fountain of the nymphs, where the poplars stand in a ring, they meet Melanthius the goatherd driving the fattest goats of the herd down for the suitors' table.
OD-B17-S02-T02.direction: gestures toward the water and the descending flock

OD-B17-S02-T03.line: Look at this. One filthy tramp leading another down to beg at better men's tables. Out of my road, before my foot teaches you where the door is.
OD-B17-S02-T03.direction: shoulders past, kicking the beggar's hip

OD-B17-S02-T04.direction: hand tightens white on the staff, then loosens; he walks on

OD-B17-S03-T01.direction: stops still at the dung heap, seeing the old hound in the flies

OD-B17-S03-T02.line: The old hound knows him. He lifts his head out of the dung, drops his ears, and beats his tail, but he has no strength left to rise and come.
OD-B17-S03-T02.direction: the tail thumps twice in the filth

OD-B17-S03-T03.line: Eumaeus, that dog on the heap. There is a fine shape under all that dirt. Was he a hunter once, or only a table dog kept for show?
OD-B17-S03-T03.direction: turns his face away and wipes a tear unseen

OD-B17-S03-T04.line: Twenty years he waited, and one look was enough. The dark of death takes Argos in the moment he has seen his master again.
OD-B17-S03-T04.direction: the tail stills, the head goes down for the last time

OD-B17-S04-T01.line: Wait here at the threshold, friend, and come in when I call you.
OD-B17-S04-T01.direction: steps in first; the prince nods him toward the door stool

OD-B17-S04-T02.direction: sits on the ash-wood sill of his own house, listening to the singer

OD-B17-S04-T03.line: Give what you can spare, my lord. You have plenty and it costs you nothing. I was a rich man once with a house of my own, and I fed every wanderer who came to my door.
OD-B17-S04-T03.direction: moves down the tables with his hand out, reading each face

OD-B17-S04-T04.line: Man after man drops food in his bag, half from pity, half from habit. Then Antinous rises and demands to know who let this thing in through the door.
OD-B17-S04-T04.direction: sweeps a hand along the crowded tables

OD-B17-S05-T01.line: I had a house and men of my own once, and I gave to any beggar who came. Then Egypt swallowed it. My crew were cut down along the river and I was sold from hand to hand until I came to this door.
OD-B17-S05-T01.direction: holds out the bag, steady under the stare

OD-B17-S05-T02.line: What god dumped this plague on our dinner? Back from the table, you shameless thing, before you find an Egypt worse than the first.
OD-B17-S05-T02.direction: shoves the wine away and stands

OD-B17-S05-T03.line: Your body is handsome, but there is no mind inside it. Sitting in another man's house you would not give a grain of salt from a table that is not yours.

OD-B17-S05-T04.line: Take it then, and beg from where you fall.
OD-B17-S05-T04.direction: hurls the footstool into his right shoulder

OD-B17-S05-T05.line: Hear me, gods, and you avengers of the poor, if a beggar has any claim on heaven. Let Antinous meet his death before his wedding day.
OD-B17-S05-T05.direction: stands rooted as a rock, shaking his head slowly

OD-B17-S05-T06.line: Even the suitors cannot stomach it. One of them says aloud what all of them are thinking: strike a stranger at the door, and it may be a god you have struck.

OD-B17-S06-T01.line: They struck a guest in my own house and he bore it without a sound? Eumaeus, bring the man up to me. I want to hear where he has wandered, and whether he has heard any word of Odysseus.
OD-B17-S06-T01.direction: sets down the wool and leans forward

OD-B17-S06-T02.line: Not now, and tell her so kindly. There are hard hands in that hall, and one has already found me. Let me come to her at dusk when the light is gone.
OD-B17-S06-T02.direction: touches his bruised shoulder and nods toward the hall

OD-B17-S06-T03.line: The stranger is no fool. He sees these men for exactly what they are. Let him come when the hall empties, and he will sit by my fire and say whatever he likes.
OD-B17-S06-T03.direction: smiles faintly and draws her chair to the hearth

OD-B17-S06-T04.direction: a huge sneeze cracks off the rafters

OD-B17-S06-T05.line: Did you hear that? My words are sealed. Every one of these men will meet his death.

OD-B17-S07-T01.line: The pigs want me before dawn, my lord. Shall I go back up to the farm tonight, or is there something here you want done first?
OD-B17-S07-T01.direction: waits by the door with his stick

OD-B17-S07-T02.line: Eat first, then go. Come back at daybreak with good beasts for the table, and with whatever the country is saying.
OD-B17-S07-T02.direction: presses bread and meat into his hands

OD-B17-S07-T03.line: Keep well, both of you. I will be back with the light.
OD-B17-S07-T03.direction: clasps the prince's arm, nods to the beggar, and goes out

OD-B17-S07-T04.direction: settles into the ash by the door, counting faces in the firelight

OD-B18-S01-T01.line: Peace, friend. This threshold is wide enough for two hungry men.
OD-B18-S01-T01.direction: shifts aside but keeps his seat

OD-B18-S01-T02.line: Bark all you like, big belly. I have taken no crust out of your mouth yet.
OD-B18-S01-T02.direction: rises slowly as the suitors crowd in

OD-B18-S01-T03.line: Goat bellies are sizzling on our fire, friends. The winner takes the fattest and eats with us from this night on. The loser begs at no door of ours again.
OD-B18-S01-T03.direction: lifts a blood pudding from the coals

OD-B18-S01-T04.line: Swear to me first that no hand in this hall strikes me from behind. An old man cannot fight one belly and a whole house at once.
OD-B18-S01-T04.direction: turns full circle, waiting for the oath

OD-B18-S02-T01.line: Look, then. The rags come up, and you may all see what the sea left me.
OD-B18-S02-T01.direction: belts his rags high, bares thigh and shoulder

OD-B18-S02-T02.line: Stand taller, man of many turns. Let them see the shoulders I remember.
OD-B18-S02-T02.direction: unseen, breathes size into his limbs

OD-B18-S02-T03.line: This one is old. I said he was old. Let me go.
OD-B18-S02-T03.direction: shakes, is dragged into the ring

OD-B18-S02-T04.direction: checks the killing blow, strikes once below the ear

OD-B18-S02-T05.line: Sit there in the dirt and keep the dogs and the pigs off yourself. You were king of the beggars an hour ago. Come back to this gate and you will not walk away from it.
OD-B18-S02-T05.direction: props him against the courtyard gate

OD-B18-S02-T06.line: The suitors laugh until the rafters take it up, and Amphinomus sets bread and a golden cup before the victor. Good fortune to you hereafter, stranger, he says. He does not know what he is wishing on himself.
OD-B18-S02-T06.direction: steps forward as the hall roars

OD-B18-S03-T01.line: Amphinomus, of all these men you seem to carry sense, so hear me. Earth breeds nothing feebler than a man, and no man should walk lawless because the season is kind to him.
OD-B18-S03-T01.direction: raises the cup to him, holds his eye

OD-B18-S03-T02.line: The master of this house is nearer than any of you believe. I pray some god carries you home before he crosses his own threshold, for when he comes there will be blood between him and these suitors.
OD-B18-S03-T02.direction: sets the cup down, does not look away

OD-B18-S03-T03.line: May it be as you say, old man.
OD-B18-S03-T03.direction: walks back to his seat, head down

OD-B18-S03-T04.line: He goes shaking, and he does not go home. Athena has already bound him to this hall, and the spear of Telemachus is waiting for him. That is the third door held open before the killing, and the third man who will not walk through it.
OD-B18-S03-T04.direction: watches him return to the benches

OD-B18-S04-T01.line: Go down among them, Penelope, and shine. Let their knees go weak and their hands go to their treasure chests.
OD-B18-S04-T01.direction: stands unseen at the queen's door

OD-B18-S04-T02.line: Sleep now, daughter of Icarius. I will make you taller than you were and whiter than cut ivory, and wake you at the right moment.
OD-B18-S04-T02.direction: pours sleep and beauty over her

OD-B18-S04-T03.line: Telemachus, your mind was steadier when you were a boy. You let a guest be mauled under this roof, and the shame of it lies on us, not on him.
OD-B18-S04-T03.direction: descends with two maids, veil held at her cheek

OD-B18-S04-T04.line: When Odysseus left me he took my wrist and said, when the boy's beard shows, marry whom you will. That day has come. But what suitors are you, who eat another man's cattle and bring the bride nothing?
OD-B18-S04-T04.direction: stands at the pillar, addresses them all

OD-B18-S04-T05.line: The heralds run, and back come robes and earrings and chains of worked gold. In the shadow by the door Odysseus is smiling, because she is stripping them of their wealth while her heart is somewhere else entirely.

OD-B18-S05-T01.line: I go up. Let the house be lit.
OD-B18-S05-T01.direction: climbs the stair as the maids kindle braziers

OD-B18-S05-T02.line: Still here, stranger? Go sleep in a smithy or a tavern, and stop blinking at your betters by our own fire.
OD-B18-S05-T02.direction: leans over him with a torch

OD-B18-S05-T03.line: Eurymachus, he threatens us with his master's homecoming. The poor thing has had one cup of wine and now he is a prophet.

OD-B18-S05-T04.line: Stranger, that skull of yours burns brighter than the lamps, and not one hair on it. Come work my fields for wages, and see whether you can lift a stone. Or is begging the only trade that fills a belly without sweat?
OD-B18-S05-T04.direction: plays to the laughter of the hall

OD-B18-S05-T05.line: Set the two of us in deep meadow grass in spring with good scythes, and you would not see my back all day. Put us both in the front rank with spears and shields, and no one here would laugh at my bald head.

OD-B18-S05-T06.direction: hurls a footstool, misses, strikes the wine-server

OD-B18-S05-T07.line: Enough. You are full of meat and wine and you are past your own sense. I drive no man out, but this night is over. Go home to your beds.
OD-B18-S05-T07.direction: steps between them, holds the floor

OD-B19-S01-T01.line: Every spear and every shield goes out of this hall tonight, and quietly. If they ask, the smoke has eaten them. The iron itself draws a man on.
OD-B19-S01-T01.direction: speaks low with the doors shut

OD-B19-S01-T02.line: Carry on. The light is mine.
OD-B19-S01-T02.direction: lifts a golden lamp before father and son

OD-B19-S01-T03.line: Nurse, keep the women shut in their rooms until this is done. The smoke has ruined the bronze my father left. And when men are deep in wine I will not have a blade within reach of a quarrel.
OD-B19-S01-T03.direction: carries helmets past her toward the storeroom

OD-B19-S01-T04.line: The walls stand bare where the bronze hung for twenty years. The hall is stripped and swept and ready, and no man who will die in it knows what it has been made ready for.
OD-B19-S01-T04.direction: stands alone in the emptied hall

OD-B19-S02-T01.line: Bold creature, I hear you, and you will pay for it with your own head. I ordered this guest kept by my hearth, and I will question him myself.
OD-B19-S02-T01.direction: comes down to the hearth, dismisses the maid

OD-B19-S02-T02.line: Tell me now, stranger, who you are and from what people. Every man on earth has a father and a city, and I will hear yours.
OD-B19-S02-T02.direction: takes the inlaid chair, faces him

OD-B19-S02-T03.line: Three years I wove a great shroud for old Laertes by day and unpicked it again by torchlight, and they never saw it. Then a maid of mine sold me to them, and the fourth year took the last of my cunning.
OD-B19-S02-T03.direction: sits by the fire, hands empty in her lap

OD-B19-S02-T04.line: You say you gave my husband bread. Then tell me what he wore and what men stood beside him. I have buried too many lies to take another one on trust.

OD-B19-S03-T01.line: In Crete they called me Aethon, third son of Deucalion, of the line of Minos. Your husband was driven to my shore by a north wind, and I gave him bread and dark wine for twelve days.
OD-B19-S03-T01.direction: keeps his voice level and his eyes dry

OD-B19-S03-T02.line: He wore a purple cloak of double fold, pinned with a golden brooch: a hound holding a dappled fawn in its forepaws, the fawn struggling, both of them worked in gold. His tunic shone like the skin of a dried onion. His herald was Eurybates, round in the shoulders, dark, with curling hair, and your husband honored him above every other man.
OD-B19-S03-T02.direction: counts each detail off on his fingers

OD-B19-S03-T03.line: I gave him that brooch with my own hands.
OD-B19-S03-T03.direction: weeps; her face runs like thawing snow

OD-B19-S03-T04.line: Stranger, you were pitied in this house an hour ago. Now you will be loved in it and honored. Those were my gifts, folded by me, and no living man could have known them who had not stood beside him.
OD-B19-S03-T04.direction: rises, steadies herself on the chair

OD-B19-S03-T05.line: You swear to me he is near, and comes before this moon is dead. Then hear my own oath, stranger. If he crosses that threshold, no one alive will ever call you beggar again.
OD-B19-S03-T05.direction: swears with her hand on the chair-back

OD-B19-S04-T01.line: Eurycleia, rise and wash the feet of your master's age-mate. By now the hands and feet of Odysseus must be worn as this man's are, if he is still under the sun.
OD-B19-S04-T01.direction: signals for the basin and warm water

OD-B19-S04-T02.line: Let it be done here, away from the fire.
OD-B19-S04-T02.direction: turns into the shadow, shifts his scarred leg

OD-B19-S04-T03.line: She takes the leg into her old hands, and her palm finds the long white ridge above the knee. The basin tips. Twenty years come back to her through one seam of skin.
OD-B19-S04-T03.direction: moves in close to the basin

OD-B19-S04-T04.line: Odysseus. It is you, dear child, and I did not know my own king until I touched him.
OD-B19-S04-T04.direction: the foot slips, water floods the floor, she turns toward Penelope

OD-B19-S04-T05.line: Nurse, would you destroy me? You fed me at your own breast, and now you will be silent, or when the gods put this house back in my hands I will not spare even you.
OD-B19-S04-T05.direction: seizes her throat, draws her close, whispers

OD-B19-S05-T01.line: That scar is older than Troy. It was cut on the day the boy Odysseus climbed to the house of Autolycus, his mother's father, who had named him and promised him gifts.
OD-B19-S05-T01.direction: steps out of the hall into memory

OD-B19-S05-T02.line: At first light they go out with the hounds, the sons of Autolycus and the boy among them, up the wooded flanks of Parnassus. The sun is just striking the folds of the mountain.
OD-B19-S05-T02.direction: walks the slope with the hunters

OD-B19-S05-T03.line: In a thicket so dense no wet wind ever entered it, the boar is lying. It hears the feet and the dogs, and it comes out with its bristles up and fire standing in its eyes.

OD-B19-S05-T04.direction: drives the spear through its shoulder as the tusk rips above his knee

OD-B19-S05-T05.line: The sons of Autolycus bind the wound with skill and stop the dark blood with a chanted charm. They carry the boy down to the house, heal him, and send him home to Ithaca loaded with gifts. He carried the mark of it into every year that followed.
OD-B19-S05-T05.direction: closes the memory, returns to the hall

OD-B19-S06-T01.line: Hear my dream, stranger, and tell me what it means. Twenty geese feed at my trough and I love to watch them. Then a great eagle stoops from the mountain and breaks the neck of every one.
OD-B19-S06-T01.direction: sits again beside him, quieter now

OD-B19-S06-T02.line: Then the eagle comes back and speaks with a man's voice, and the voice is his. Take heart, it says. This is no dream but a waking thing that will be done. The geese are the suitors, and I am your husband, come home.
OD-B19-S06-T02.direction: speaks the eagle's words into the room

OD-B19-S06-T03.line: There is no second reading of it, lady. The dream has told you its own meaning, and it has named the day of their death.

OD-B19-S06-T04.line: Tomorrow I will set out the great bow of Odysseus and the twelve axes he used to line up and shoot an arrow through. Whoever strings that bow and sends the shaft clean through them all, that man I will follow. And I will leave this house that I loved.
OD-B19-S06-T04.direction: declares it to the empty hall

OD-B19-S06-T05.line: Dreams come through two gates, stranger: one of horn that comes true, one of ivory that lies to us. I think mine came the wrong way. Good night to you.
OD-B19-S06-T05.direction: climbs to her room; Athena closes her eyes

OD-B20-S01-T01.line: Endure, my heart. You endured worse in the cave of the Cyclops.
OD-B20-S01-T01.direction: lie rigid on the oxhide, counting the maids as they pass

OD-B20-S02-T01.line: Father Zeus, if you led me home over dry land and water, give me two signs. Let a voice speak inside the house, and let your thunder speak outside it.
OD-B20-S02-T01.direction: kneel low in the doorway, palms turned up

OD-B20-S01-T02.line: Why do you lie awake, unhappiest of men? This is your house. Your wife is inside it, and the son any man would pray for. What more do you want of me?
OD-B20-S01-T02.direction: stand over him in the dark, unhurried

OD-B20-S01-T03.line: I am with you, and I never leave you. If fifty companies of men stood against us with spears, you would drive off their cattle by morning. Sleep now. I lay it on your eyes myself.
OD-B20-S01-T03.direction: pass a hand across his eyes and close them

OD-B20-S01-T04.line: Artemis, holy lady, put your arrow in my breast tonight, or let a storm take me and drop me where the sea runs out. I dreamed he lay beside me with the face he wore the year he sailed, and I was glad, and it was not a dream but a waking thing.
OD-B20-S01-T04.direction: sit up in the dark bed, hands open in her lap

OD-B20-S02-T02.direction: one clean thunderclap from a cloudless sky

OD-B20-S02-T03.line: Father Zeus, you thundered, and there is no cloud anywhere. Then grant this to a woman at the millstone. Let this be the last meal the suitors ever eat in that hall. My knees are loosened grinding their barley. Let them be finished today.
OD-B20-S02-T03.direction: stop the millstone, straighten, speak up at the roof

OD-B20-S02-T04.direction: rise from the doorway with the beggar's stoop half gone

OD-B20-S03-T01.line: Up, girls. It is Apollo's feast day. Sweep, wet the floor, rinse every cup.
OD-B20-S03-T01.direction: clap twice and drive the maids into the hall

OD-B20-S03-T02.line: Good morning, stranger. Do the men treat you any better today, or is the house still the house it was?
OD-B20-S03-T02.direction: drive the pigs through the gate and clasp the beggar's shoulder

OD-B20-S03-T03.line: Still here, dog? Still working the doorway for scraps?
OD-B20-S03-T03.direction: shove past with the goats, clip the beggar with his shoulder

OD-B20-S03-T04.line: Forgive me, father. My eyes run when I look at you. My master would wear your rags now, if he lives.
OD-B20-S03-T04.direction: take the beggar's hand in both of his, weeping

OD-B20-S03-T05.line: Herdsman, mark what I say, and let the gods hear it. Before you drive your cattle home again, Odysseus will stand in this house, and you will see with your own eyes the suitors killed.
OD-B20-S03-T05.direction: hold his hand and lower the voice

OD-B20-S04-T01.line: Let them plot. A bird flew from the left with a living dove in its claws, and even Amphinomus went pale at it. I will eat at my own table, and no man here will tell me where to sit.
OD-B20-S04-T01.direction: take his seat by the door and set his spear against the pillar

OD-B20-S04-T02.line: The stranger has had his share like the rest of us. Here is a guest-gift from me, worthy of the bath-woman and the servants he keeps company with.
OD-B20-S04-T02.direction: lift an ox hoof from the basket and hurl it

OD-B20-S04-T03.direction: tilt the head aside, the hoof strikes the wall

OD-B20-S04-T04.line: Ctesippus, be glad you missed. If you had struck my guest, my father's spear would be in your belly and your father would be building your tomb instead of your wedding. Not one more insult in this house. I am a boy no longer, and I see everything you do.
OD-B20-S04-T04.direction: stand, spear levelled across the tables

OD-B20-S04-T05.line: Then Agelaus rose and said the prince should send his mother out to be married at last. And Telemachus answered that he would never drive his own mother from her door against her will, and the suitors had no answer to that.
OD-B20-S04-T05.direction: step forward at the edge of the hall

OD-B20-S05-T01.direction: unseen, she strikes laughter into every suitor at once

OD-B20-S05-T02.line: They laugh with jaws that will not close, and the meat they lift is dripping blood, and the tears run down their faces while they laugh.
OD-B20-S05-T02.direction: walk the line of laughing men

OD-B20-S05-T03.line: Night. Night on all of you.
OD-B20-S05-T03.direction: stand and back away from the table, staring past them

OD-B20-S05-T04.line: Your heads are wrapped in darkness and your knees are gone. The walls are running with blood, the porch is full of ghosts going down to the dark, and the sun has died out of the sky. Laugh. I am going out of this house while its door still opens.
OD-B20-S05-T04.direction: walk out through their laughter without turning

OD-B20-S05-T05.direction: meet his father's eyes across the hall and hold them

OD-B21-S01-T01.direction: set the thought of the bow in the queen's mind

OD-B21-S01-T02.direction: guide her hand to the storeroom key, the doors groan open

OD-B21-S01-T03.direction: the queen sits, the bow across her knees, and weeps

OD-B21-S01-T04.line: Two maids carry in the chest of iron, and the axes are set down ringing on the floor of the hall.
OD-B21-S01-T04.direction: clear a lane down the middle of the room

OD-B21-S02-T01.line: Hear me, lords. Here is the great bow of Odysseus. Whoever strings it with his own hands and sends an arrow clean through all twelve axes, I will go with that man, and leave this house I came to as a bride.
OD-B21-S02-T01.direction: lay the bow down before them, veil drawn

OD-B21-S02-T02.direction: look at the bow, turn aside, weep openly

OD-B21-S02-T03.line: Take your crying outside, you fools. You are spoiling her heart.

OD-B21-S02-T04.direction: trench the axes in one line, then heave three times at the bow

OD-B21-S02-T05.line: The fourth pull would have strung it. But his father moved his head, once, and the boy set the bow down and called himself weak.
OD-B21-S02-T05.direction: mark the small nod from the doorway

OD-B21-S03-T01.line: I cannot bend it. Let another try. But I tell you, this bow will take the life and the breath out of the best men here, and better to die than live on failing at what we came for.
OD-B21-S03-T01.direction: hand the bow away and sit down heavily

OD-B21-S03-T02.line: One after another they took it up, and braced it, and sweated, and set it down again, and the bow did not move.
OD-B21-S03-T02.direction: pass the bow along the line of chairs

OD-B21-S03-T03.direction: build up the fire, bring a cake of fat, grease the bow

OD-B21-S03-T04.line: It is not the marriage. It is the shame.
OD-B21-S03-T04.direction: fling the warmed bow down, hands shaking

OD-B21-S03-T05.line: Enough. It is Apollo's day. Pour the wine, and we finish this tomorrow.
OD-B21-S03-T05.direction: take the bow and prop it against the doorpost

OD-B21-S04-T01.line: If Odysseus walked through that gate this hour, which side would you two stand on?
OD-B21-S04-T01.direction: follow them into the yard, out of earshot

OD-B21-S04-T02.line: Then look. Here is the scar the boar gave me on Parnassus. I am Odysseus. I am home, in the twentieth year, and I stand in front of you.
OD-B21-S04-T02.direction: pull back the rag from the thigh

OD-B21-S04-T03.line: They took him in their arms and kissed his head and his hands, and he kissed theirs, and the sun would have gone down on their weeping if he had not stopped it.
OD-B21-S04-T03.direction: close the three of them together in the yard

OD-B21-S04-T04.line: No more tears. Eumaeus, when they shout you down, carry the bow to me anyway and put it in my hands. Philoetius, bar the courtyard gate and lash it fast. And tell Eurycleia to lock the women in their rooms and let no one out, whatever they hear.
OD-B21-S04-T04.direction: grip each man by the arm in turn

OD-B21-S05-T01.line: Hear me, lords. Let me put my hands on the bow, only to learn whether any strength is left in these arms, or whether the road has eaten it all.
OD-B21-S05-T01.direction: shuffle forward from the doorway, palms open

OD-B21-S05-T02.line: Then they roared at him, and under the anger ran a colder thing, that a beggar might do what their hands could not.
OD-B21-S05-T02.direction: turn the whole room toward the door

OD-B21-S05-T03.line: Let the stranger have the bow. He is a guest in my house, and no guest is refused here. And if he strings it, I will give him a cloak and a tunic, a spear, and a sword, and send him wherever his heart wants to go.

OD-B21-S05-T04.line: Mother, the bow is mine to give, and no man in Ithaca will overrule me in my own house. Go up to your room and your loom. The talking here belongs to the men.
OD-B21-S05-T04.direction: stand between her and the hall until she goes

OD-B21-S05-T05.direction: carry the bow through the shouting and lay it in the beggar's hands

OD-B21-S06-T01.line: Bolt them. Nobody comes out, whatever you hear.
OD-B21-S06-T01.direction: shut the women's doors and set the bar

OD-B21-S06-T02.direction: lash the courtyard gate shut with a ship's cable

OD-B21-S06-T03.direction: turn the bow slowly, checking horn and grip, ignoring the jeers

OD-B21-S06-T04.line: The doors are shut. The cable is knotted. Every way out of that hall is closed, and the men inside it are still laughing.
OD-B21-S06-T04.direction: seal the room from the edge of the light

OD-B21-S07-T01.direction: seated, string the bow in one easy motion

OD-B21-S07-T02.direction: pluck the string, a swallow's note fills the hall

OD-B21-S07-T03.line: It is time, son of Laertes. I have set my sign on the day.

OD-B21-S07-T04.direction: belt on the sword, take up the spear, stand at his father's shoulder

OD-B21-S07-T05.direction: nock, draw from the chair, the arrow clears all twelve axes

OD-B21-S07-T06.line: Telemachus, the stranger sitting in your hall has not disgraced you. I did not miss the mark, and the bow did not wear me out. Now it is the hour for supper, while there is still light, and after supper there is other sport in this house.
OD-B21-S07-T06.direction: rise from the chair, arrows loose at his feet

OD-B22-S01-T01.line: Now for another mark, one no man here has hit.
OD-B22-S01-T01.direction: strips the rags, leaps to the threshold, pours the arrows at his feet

OD-B22-S01-T02.direction: draws to the ear and looses at the throat

OD-B22-S01-T03.direction: cup falls, blood at the nostrils, table kicked over

OD-B22-S01-T04.line: Stranger, you shoot at men! Where are the shields? Where are the spears?
OD-B22-S01-T04.direction: scramble along bare walls and find nothing

OD-B22-S01-T05.line: You dogs. You never thought I would come home from Troy. You ate my house, you forced my women, you courted my wife while I still lived.
OD-B22-S01-T05.direction: holds the threshold, arrow nocked, voice level

OD-B22-S02-T01.line: Antinous is dead, and he was the cause of all of it. Take back the worth of everything we ate, and twenty oxen from each man besides.

OD-B22-S02-T02.line: Eurymachus, if you gave me all your fathers' wealth, my hands would not stop. Fight or run. Not one of you goes out of this door alive.

OD-B22-S02-T03.line: Draw your swords! Hold the tables against his arrows and rush him, and someone raise the town!
OD-B22-S02-T03.direction: lifts a table as a shield and charges

OD-B22-S02-T04.direction: arrow through the chest; the man falls doubled over the table

OD-B22-S02-T05.direction: charges Odysseus and takes a spear from behind

OD-B22-S03-T01.line: Father, I will bring arms. Four shields, four helmets, eight spears, for us and the two herdsmen.
OD-B22-S03-T01.direction: runs to the storeroom and back, arming each man

OD-B22-S03-T02.line: Father, the fault is mine. I left the storeroom door standing open. Their watchman was quicker than I was.
OD-B22-S03-T02.direction: sets the last helmet down and faces him

OD-B22-S03-T03.line: Four men stood armed at the threshold now, and while the arrows lasted the master kept shooting, and man after man went down in the dust.
OD-B22-S03-T03.direction: to the audience, plain and steady

OD-B22-S03-T04.line: When the last arrow was gone he leaned the bow against the doorpost, slung the shield on his shoulder, and took up two spears of bronze.
OD-B22-S03-T04.direction: to the audience, marking the turn to close work

OD-B22-S04-T01.line: Take heart. There is a way up to the storeroom. Twelve shields, twelve spears, twelve helmets, and I will bring them down.
OD-B22-S04-T01.direction: slips through the side passage with an armful of bronze

OD-B22-S04-T02.line: Eumaeus, Philoetius. Someone is arming them out of my own storeroom. Go up, find him, and bring me his hands tied behind his back.
OD-B22-S04-T02.direction: spear steady on the hall, eyes on the side door

OD-B22-S04-T03.direction: seize Melanthius by the hair as he reaches for a helmet

OD-B22-S04-T04.line: Lie up there, Melanthius, and keep your soft bed. You will see the dawn before any man in this house.
OD-B22-S04-T04.direction: hands and feet bound, hauled by rope to the roof beam

OD-B22-S05-T01.line: Odysseus, I have not forgotten you.
OD-B22-S05-T01.direction: enters at the door in Mentor's shape

OD-B22-S05-T02.line: Mentor, keep ruin off me. Remember the friend who honored you all his life. Or have you come late on purpose, now the work is nearly done?
OD-B22-S05-T02.direction: half a glance sideways, spear never dropping

OD-B22-S05-T03.line: Then watch me, Mentor. The man who fought nine years under Troy is still standing in this doorway.
OD-B22-S05-T03.direction: steps down into the hall, spear leveled

OD-B22-S05-T04.line: Six spears the suitors hurled together at the threshold, and every one of them was thrown to kill.
OD-B22-S05-T04.direction: to the audience, the volley in the air

OD-B22-S05-T05.direction: turns the spears aside into doorpost and wall

OD-B22-S05-T06.line: Then the four cast as one, and four men fell, and the hall filled with the noise of the dying.
OD-B22-S05-T06.direction: to the audience, counting the fallen

OD-B22-S05-T07.direction: raises the aegis from the roof beam; the suitors stampede like driven cattle

OD-B22-S06-T01.direction: drives them down the hall like falcons among small birds

OD-B22-S06-T02.line: You were their diviner, Leiodes, and you prayed often enough for my wife's hand. There is no mercy in me for that.
OD-B22-S06-T02.direction: strikes as the man clasps his knees

OD-B22-S06-T03.line: Spare me, Odysseus, and pity me. No man taught me my songs but a god, and I came into this hall under force, not for love of them.
OD-B22-S06-T03.direction: kneels holding the lyre up between them

OD-B22-S06-T04.line: Live, both of you. My son has spoken for you. Go out to the courtyard and sit by the altar until this work is finished.
OD-B22-S06-T04.direction: points them past the threshold with the spear

OD-B22-S06-T05.line: They searched the hall for any man still breathing, and found them all fallen in blood and dust, like fish poured out upon the sand.
OD-B22-S06-T05.direction: to the audience, walking the ruin

OD-B22-S07-T01.line: Twelve of you went the shameless way. You lay with them, and you laughed at me, and you laughed at your queen. Stand out from the others; he knows your names now.
OD-B22-S07-T01.direction: separates twelve women from the rest

OD-B22-S07-T02.line: The women carried the bodies out under the porch, and scoured the tables and the floor with water and sponges until the hall was clean.

OD-B22-S07-T03.line: No clean death for them, not by my sword. They poured shame on my head and on my mother's while she lay alone.
OD-B22-S07-T03.direction: runs a cable from the pillar to the round house

OD-B22-S07-T04.line: They brought Melanthius down into the court and cut him apart, and gave what was left to the dogs.
OD-B22-S07-T04.direction: to the audience, flat, no relish

OD-B22-S07-T05.line: So the house was emptied of its false servants, and everything that had rotted inside it was carried out into the light.
OD-B22-S07-T05.direction: to the audience, closing the account

OD-B22-S08-T01.line: Rejoice in your heart, old woman, but not aloud. It is not holy to crow over dead men. Bring me fire and sulphur now, and I will cleanse this hall.
OD-B22-S08-T01.direction: checks her cry of triumph with a raised hand

OD-B22-S08-T02.direction: crowd in with torches, weeping, kissing his hands

OD-B22-S08-T03.line: Gently now. The doors stay shut until I say otherwise.
OD-B22-S08-T03.direction: holds each of them briefly, eyes on the entrances

OD-B22-S08-T04.line: Go up now and wake your mistress. Tell her the man she waited for is standing in his own hall.

OD-B23-S01-T01.line: Wake, my child, wake and see it with your own eyes. Odysseus is home, here in this house, and every suitor lies dead in the hall. The man you have mourned twenty years is sitting by his own fire.
OD-B23-S01-T01.direction: breathless at the bedside, shaking her

OD-B23-S01-T02.line: No. The gods have broken your wits, poor nurse.

OD-B23-S01-T03.line: The scar, child, the scar. I washed it with these hands.
OD-B23-S01-T03.direction: mimes gripping the old wound, pulls her up

OD-B23-S01-T04.direction: descends the stair, stops short of him

OD-B23-S02-T01.direction: sits opposite, studies his face in silence

OD-B23-S02-T02.line: Mother, no other woman has a heart like this.
OD-B23-S02-T02.direction: steps between them, hot with anger

OD-B23-S02-T03.line: She will not come near you, father. She says the two of you keep signs no other soul has ever heard. Until those signs are spoken, she says, I am no son of hers to argue it.

OD-B23-S02-T04.line: Let her take her time; my wife will know me in her own hour. There is a colder danger at the door. Kill one man in this land and his kinsmen come armed, and we have killed the flower of Ithaca.

OD-B23-S02-T05.line: Wash yourselves and put on fresh tunics; let the singer strike up a wedding tune. Let every man who passes this gate say the queen has married at last. No word of the dead leaves this house until I give it.
OD-B23-S02-T05.direction: flat command to the whole household

OD-B23-S03-T01.direction: rises from the bath, transfigured, taller

OD-B23-S03-T02.line: Sound the wedding. Dance, all of you, dance loud.
OD-B23-S03-T02.direction: strikes up a bright false wedding tune

OD-B23-S03-T03.line: Strange woman. The gods have given you a heart that nothing softens. Then let it stand; nurse, make up a bed for me alone, and I will sleep apart in my own house.

OD-B23-S03-T04.line: No other wife would sit across the room from a husband home in the twentieth year, worn down by salt and war. Your heart is harder than the stone under this floor.

OD-B23-S04-T01.line: Eurycleia, carry the great bed out of the bridal chamber and set it up in the hall. Spread the fleeces and the bright blankets on it for him there.

OD-B23-S04-T02.line: Woman, who has moved my bed? I built it myself around a living olive trunk still rooted in the ground, and I roofed the chamber over it. No man alive could shift that bed without taking an axe to the tree.
OD-B23-S04-T02.direction: erupts from the chair, voice cracking

OD-B23-S04-T03.line: The sign is given, and it is his alone: the bed that cannot be carried, the secret two people kept. See how her knees go slack beneath her.
OD-B23-S04-T03.direction: to the audience, low and steady

OD-B23-S04-T04.direction: runs, throws both arms round his neck

OD-B23-S04-T05.line: Do not be angry with me; of all men you were always the shrewdest. I was afraid some stranger would come with a smooth story and take me with it. Now the sign has come and my heart gives way, and you are as welcome to me as dry land to swimmers.

OD-B23-S04-T06.direction: holds dawn back below the horizon

OD-B23-S05-T01.direction: tells the years, her hand in his

OD-B23-S05-T02.line: One labour is still on me. Tiresias bids me walk inland with an oar on my shoulder until I come to men who know nothing of the sea. Where a stranger calls it a winnowing fan, there I plant it and make my peace with Poseidon.

OD-B23-S05-T03.line: And then a gentle death, out of the sea, in a rich old age.

OD-B23-S05-T04.line: If the gods have set a better old age at the end of that road, then go when you must go. I have waited before; I know the shape of waiting. Only come back to this bed.

OD-B23-S06-T02.line: Stay within doors, all of you, and bar them; let no woman lean out to look. Word of the dead will run through the town before noon. See nothing, say nothing, until I send for you.

OD-B23-S06-T03.direction: draws night around the four men

OD-B23-S06-T04.direction: speeds them toward the orchard farm

OD-B24-S01-T01.line: This way, all of you. Come along.
OD-B24-S01-T01.direction: sweeps the shades up with the golden wand

OD-B24-S01-T02.direction: leads them past ocean, white rock, dream-gates

OD-B24-S01-T03.line: Here in the meadow of asphodel the great dead are standing: Achilles, and Ajax still turned away, and Agamemnon among his murdered men. Into that grey company the suitors come squeaking like bats in the roof of a cave.
OD-B24-S01-T03.direction: to the audience, cold and clear

OD-B24-S01-T04.line: The dead press close, for never has such a crowd of young lords come down in one day. Tell us, they ask, what harvest cut all of you together.
OD-B24-S01-T04.direction: to the audience, drawing them in

OD-B24-S02-T01.line: Achilles and Agamemnon weigh their deaths against each other: the one burned in glory beside the ships, the other butchered at his own table by his own wife. Then Agamemnon turns and sees the new arrivals, and asks them their story.

OD-B24-S02-T02.line: Hear Amphimedon, who tells it whole: a queen who wove a shroud by day and unwove it by night, three years of that cunning. A beggar at the door whom none of us knew. The great bow strung at last, and the arrows turning on us in the hall.
OD-B24-S02-T02.direction: to the audience, quick and grim

OD-B24-S02-T03.line: And Agamemnon cries out: blessed son of Laertes, what a wife you won. Penelope kept faith, and the gods will make a song of her that never dies. Mine murdered me at meat, and her song will be a curse laid on every woman after her.

OD-B24-S02-T04.line: So the dead learn a new song, and for once it is not a lament. The house held. The master came home. Even down here the singer takes it up.
OD-B24-S02-T04.direction: to the audience, closing the scene

OD-B24-S03-T01.direction: watches the old man hoe, unseen

OD-B24-S03-T02.line: Go on ahead. Kill the best pig and set the fire.

OD-B24-S03-T03.line: I hosted Odysseus once, old man, five years gone, and sent him off with gifts.

OD-B24-S03-T04.line: Father, put down the dust. I am the man you are grieving. I am Odysseus, home in the twentieth year, and the suitors lie dead in my hall.

OD-B24-S03-T05.line: If you are truly my son, give me a sign I cannot argue with. Grief has made me easy to fool, and I will not be fooled a second time. Tell me something no stranger on earth could know.
OD-B24-S03-T05.direction: holds him at arm's length, trembling

OD-B24-S04-T01.line: Here. The boar of Parnassus left me this.
OD-B24-S04-T01.direction: lifts the tunic, bares the white scar

OD-B24-S04-T02.line: And count the trees you gave me when I was a boy trailing you down these rows. Thirteen pear, ten apple, forty fig, and fifty rows of vines, each ripening in its own season. I begged them off you and you named them to me one by one.

OD-B24-S04-T03.direction: knees fail; falls into his arms

OD-B24-S04-T04.line: But who in Ithaca will stand with us now?
OD-B24-S04-T04.direction: grips him, glances toward the road

OD-B24-S05-T01.direction: bathed and oiled inside the farmhouse

OD-B24-S05-T02.direction: straightens him, broadens the old shoulders

OD-B24-S05-T03.line: Master. You are home, you are truly home.
OD-B24-S05-T03.direction: drops his tools, seizes his hand

OD-B24-S05-T04.line: They sit down to meat together, master and old servants, the house whole for one hour. But in the town below the rumour is going door to door. It is coming toward this table.

OD-B24-S06-T01.line: All morning they carry the bodies out of the palace, each family claiming its own. Ithaca has not wept like this since the ships went to Troy. Eupithes, your son Antinous lies first among them.
OD-B24-S06-T01.direction: to the audience, then to Eupithes

OD-B24-S06-T02.line: We were there. A god stood at his shoulder in that hall.
OD-B24-S06-T02.direction: step out shaking before the assembly

OD-B24-S06-T03.line: I warned you, Ithacans, and you sat on your hands. Your own sons ate another man's house, and you let them. Do not add a second madness to the first.
OD-B24-S06-T03.direction: raises a hand over the crowd

OD-B24-S06-T04.line: Do not preach patience to me across my son's body. They lie in the dust while the man who killed them sits down to supper. Take up your spears and come to the farm before he slips away by sea.
OD-B24-S06-T04.direction: turns his back, marching them out

OD-B24-S06-T05.line: More than half rise and follow him through the gates. The rest keep their seats, unwilling to buy one more grave with another. From this hour there are two Ithacas.

OD-B24-S07-T01.line: Father Zeus, son of Cronos, highest of the lords, tell me what you hide behind that brow. Will you stretch this killing out longer, or set peace between them?
OD-B24-S07-T01.direction: steps close to the throne, weighing his face

OD-B24-S07-T02.line: My child, the suitors are paid what they earned. Let Odysseus be king over them all the days of his life. That is my word, and it stands.

OD-B24-S07-T03.line: Now make them swear an oath, and let the slaughter of their sons be forgotten. Wealth and friendship as before, and peace in abundance. Go down and see it done.
OD-B24-S07-T03.direction: a small gesture toward the world below

OD-B24-S07-T04.direction: drops from the peaks of Olympus toward Ithaca

OD-B24-S08-T01.direction: presses spears into the hands of herdsmen and old men

OD-B24-S08-T02.line: Son of Arceisius, dearest of all my friends, pray to the bright-eyed maiden and to Father Zeus. Then lift your long spear and throw it. The strength is in you still.
OD-B24-S08-T02.direction: wearing Mentor's face, gripping the old man's arm

OD-B24-S08-T03.line: Hear me, Athena, daughter of Zeus, and stand beside me as you stood in my green years. Give me one true throw. What a day of joy this is for me, my son and my son's son striving together in valour!
OD-B24-S08-T03.direction: prays, then hurls the spear through Eupithes' bronze cheek-piece

OD-B24-S08-T04.direction: charges with sword and spear, Telemachus at his shoulder

OD-B24-S08-T05.line: So the fathers of the slain went down among their own dead, and the slaughter of the hall began again under open sky. Ithaca stood one blow from eating itself alive.

OD-B24-S09-T01.line: Hold, men of Ithaca! Break off this bitter war, and part before more blood is spilled.
OD-B24-S09-T01.direction: a cry that stops every hand mid-strike

OD-B24-S09-T02.direction: a smoking bolt cracks down at Athena's feet

OD-B24-S09-T03.line: They break and run, and everything in me stoops after them like an eagle. But that was the bolt of Zeus at your feet, and I will not argue with it. I hold.

OD-B24-S09-T04.direction: clasps hands with the Ithacans over the oath

OD-B24-S09-T05.line: So Pallas Athena, wearing the shape and the voice of Mentor, set binding oaths between the king and his people. The blood stopped, and the house of Odysseus stood whole. And there the singing ends.
OD-B24-S09-T05.direction: narrating to the audience, letting it settle
